Join us THIS SATURDAY in Lake Butler for a stop on the Defending the Florida Dream Tour.

Doors open at 12:30 PM, we’ll see you there!

RSVP HERE: byrondonalds.com/lakebutler

Welcome to the Sunshine State, Freddy!

Can’t go wrong with some great Florida seafood, and I also recommend sampling a Pub Sub at @publix. It doesn’t get better.


Freddy🇩🇪 (@FreddyLA7)

We’ve made it to the fourth state of our trip. 

FLORIDA! THE SUNSHINE STATE!!!! IT’S SO HOT WE NEED TO GET TO THE BEACH IMMEDIATELY!!!!





— https://nitter.net/FreddyLA7/status/2064813038104949154#m

Congratulations, @KatieMiller and @StephenM, on the beautiful new addition to your family!

Erika and I are completely overjoyed for you.


Katie Miller (@KatieMiller)

It’s been a very exciting week in the Miller household. 

Hawthorne Hayes Miller was born on June 3rd at 9:04am growing our crew to 4 kids 5 and under. 

Babies are the absolute best. Our home is filled with so much love, laughter, and joy.

It’s an incredible feeling to know that you can make an entire person from scratch. I tru

The Radical Left doesn’t want secure borders. They don’t want safer streets. They don’t want you to live life affordably.

I’ve fought like hell alongside President Trump to defeat their radical policies.

Now, I’m ready to bring the fight to Tallahassee as Governor.

Video

Congratulations to the crew of the Artemis III mission, which will launch from Florida in 2027!

Especially happy to see two Floridians in the crew — astronauts Andre Douglas and Frank Rubio.
nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-m…

I had a truly moving, special experience at New Way Church in Palm Coast this past Sunday morning.

Video
  



Video

I’m proud to announce that I have officially qualified as a candidate for Florida Governor. 

We’re not letting our foot off the gas — we are going to continue making our case in every corner of this great state. 

I’ll never stop fighting to make your life more affordable and defend the Florida Dream for the next generation.
🚨Watch now: HotCakes & Hot Takes with @VincentOshana piped.video/jCr4plYieR8?si=9aaz… via @YouTube

Blue states can and will undermine elections in real time.

This is why we need the SAVE America Act — now more than ever.


Decision Desk HQ (@DecisionDeskHQ)

Decision Desk HQ projects Nithya Raman wins the second of two spots in the CA Los Angeles Mayor Nonpartisan Primary

#DecisionMade: 7:57 PM EDT





— https://nitter.net/DecisionDeskHQ/status/2063772730437075457#m

If there’s one thing I’ve learned from running for the State House in 2016, to Congress in 2020, and now for Governor of the Sunshine State — you have to knock doors.

Getting the chance to meet and talk with voters where they are has always been my favorite part of the campaign trail. 

A GREAT afternoon in Flagler County.







Video

My full remarks and Q&A at VFW post 8696 in Flagler County

Video

Out knocking doors with my team in Flagler County today!

Join us as we cover the state! 

byrondonalds.com/volunteer

Video

Started the day at The Southern Table in Bunnell with great food and even better conversation.

Thank you to Janine and the entire team for your hospitality.

If you’re passing through Flagler County, do yourself a favor and order the blueberry pancakes!

To you, it's just a Cracker Barrel parking lot. To me, it's where I gave my life to Jesus Christ.

I was 21 years old. I was working at the Cracker Barrel in Tallahassee after some of the worst years of my life. I'd made mistakes. Real ones.

I grew up in Crown Heights, Brooklyn, raised by a mom who worked hard and didn't accept excuses. But I made decisions that should have ended my story before it ever really started. By the grace of God, they didn't. But every day, I was carrying them.

One a

The energy at VFW Post 8696 in Flagler County was off the charts!

It was great to be with old friends, new supporters, veterans who call the Sunshine State home.

Working together, we’ll defend the Florida Dream.

Video

Made a new friend, Brooks, at the Silver Spurs Rodeo in Kissimmee last night.

Video

Had a great time meeting Floridians at the Martin County GOP Picnic!

Across the state, Floridians are telling me the same thing, they want Florida to remain Florida. I’m fighting everyday to make sure everyone has a shot at living the Florida Dream.

Thank you, Martin County, we can't wait to be back. Now it's on to Palm Coast for the next stop on the Defending the Florida Dream Tour!
